title: Verify authenticity and bibliographic accuracy of every reference
scope: Main.tex thebibliography entries only; do not touch prose, equations, figures or experiments
method: Per-entry web evidence (publisher/DOI/arXiv/official record), record verdict and source URL; fix clear factual errors, escalate ambiguous ones to user
done_when: Every entry has an evidence-backed verdict: verified / corrected / not-found / unresolved
Each verdict cites at least one authoritative source URL
Clear factual errors corrected in Main.tex; ambiguous cases listed for user decision
Bibliography still compiles with no new undefined citations
Report with per-entry table written to .project-log/docs
limits: Cannot access paywalled full text; venue/volume/page data checked against publisher metadata, DBLP, arXiv or journal ToC
